overall_status: 104四帧通过；105前三帧可用，105s04连续性待主代理修正。主代理将自行登记选用修订文件；本记录保留原版和实际局限。
constraints: 未修改旧单图、既有进度JSON或仓库；所有规范步骤图以首次创建方式保存，无覆盖。弃用尝试保留生成工具默认源位置。

frames.full_prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Generate exactly one rehabilitation exercise photograph matching reference image 1, which is the camera and scene anchor. Preserve camera position, perspective, image crop, focal length, floor level, chair geometry and placement against left wall, fixed front rail geometry and placement, light, shadow style and the exact same woman including identity, white T-shirt, charcoal trousers and white trainers. IMPORTANT: Do not zoom in on the seated figure, do not recenter furniture, do not enlarge her head. Leave large empty blue-gray upper space where the standing woman's head was. Change only the woman's posture from standing to sitting on the front half of this same chair, facing right. STEP 01: Hips securely supported on front half of chair seat; torso upright; knees about 90 degrees, both feet flat fully planted shoulder-width, shoes remain on the same floor plane; hands relaxed on thighs and not on the rail. Chair back stays against left wall. Fixed rail remains in the same spot as anchor and is reachable after standing. One woman, one pose, realistic limbs and fingers, full body, both shoes visible; no text, numbers, arrows, watermark, montage, ghosts.

review.method: 生成展示后view_image逐张检查，复制至final_path后再次view_image逐张查看。
review.target_pose: 坐在椅前半部、双脚全掌落地，双手放大腿；前方固定扶栏可及。
review.support_and_contact: 椅背可见贴靠左墙、臀部接椅、双鞋接地；未扶栏。
review.proportion_joint_and_framing: 四肢关节连贯，头身及上下肢长度自然，完整双手双脚在镜头内。
review.identity_style: 同女性、黑马尾、白短袖、深灰裤、白鞋；灰蓝背景柔光；组内固定相机构图及家具大体一致。

frames.full_prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. One photorealistic exercise step photograph. Image 1 is the exact fixed-camera standing scene; image 2 is its seated beginning. Preserve camera viewpoint, framing, left-wall chair position and geometry, rail position and floor bolts, floor baseline, light, the same adult East Asian woman and natural body proportions, face, ponytail, white T-shirt, charcoal trousers, white trainers. Keep scale fixed, no automatic portrait enlargement. STEP 02 ONLY: intermediate sit-to-stand beginning, facing right. Both feet are flat fully planted at the same seated foot placement, body center has moved forward over feet, torso inclined forward from hips with natural straight back, hips visibly lifted about 10-15 cm ABOVE AND A LITTLE FORWARD OF the chair seat leaving a clear gap below buttocks; knees and hips still substantially bent, not fully standing yet. Hands may press gently on own thighs just above knees as she rises, both arms belong to her and palms contact own thighs realistically. No hand on rail yet. Neither heel lifts, no jump. Fixed support remains ahead within reach once upright. Head, both hands, feet, seat gap, empty seat and rail completely visible. Single pose only; no arrows, text, numbers, watermark, ghost bodies, collage or extra limbs.

review.target_pose: 前移后开始起身，髋已离椅，膝髋仍屈曲、双脚全掌落地。
review.support_and_contact: 臀下清楚留空，双手接自己大腿，未同时提踵；椅栏位置延续。
review.proportion_joint_and_framing: 髋膝屈曲、腿长、手臂及手指目视自然，无多余肢体。
review.identity_style: 同女性、黑马尾、白短袖、深灰裤、白鞋；灰蓝背景柔光；组内固定相机构图及家具大体一致。

frames.full_prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one photorealistic rehabilitation exercise step photograph, portrait 1122x1402 style. Match the same East Asian adult woman, face, black ponytail, skin, white short sleeve T-shirt, charcoal fitted long trousers and white trainers from the three reference photos. attempts.full_prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. One photorealistic rehabilitation exercise step image, 1122x1402 portrait. Image 1 is a shallow lunge with LEFT leg forward, image 2 is a nearly correct collected standing result whose FEET have drifted backward. Create the corrected collected standing photograph. LOCK image 1 camera framing, geometry of long rail and its two posts, floor level, woman identity/face/hair/clothing/proportions and scale. Show one woman facing SCREEN RIGHT, torso fully upright, knees naturally straight, RIGHT hand touching the continuous rail farther right than in image 1, left arm relaxed. THE LEFT FRONT SHOE FROM IMAGE 1 MUST STAY IN EXACTLY ITS CURRENT FORWARD LOCATION: its heel is about x600 and toe about x770 in the 1122 pixel wide frame. Keep that left shoe shape, angle and floor location. Bring ONLY the back RIGHT FOOT forward next to it at comfortable hip width so both shoes are flat side by side near x620-790. Pelvis and head move right to stand vertically above these forward feet, woman's torso centered around x680. This is a final stable standing pose after gathering the back foot, NOT a step backwards and not at the initial starting point. Both hands and full feet visible; no heel raise, crossed feet, motion blur, text, numbers, arrows, logo, panel or ghost limbs. Keep floor contact shadows natural.
attempts.reason: 试图锁前脚落点，结果仍约保留原后移，未复制到交付目录。

attempts.full_prompt: 精确局部姿势编辑：只用这张弓步照片作为相机、人物、服装、背景、栏杆及前脚位置的唯一基准。生成一张同场景的动作终点照片，画面里仍只有这一个女人，无文字无箭头。保持固定相机和原图构图不变，栏杆、左右两个立柱、地平基准全部不动，人物头身比和四肢长度不变。她面朝右，右手一直扶住原长栏杆。把原来留在画面左侧的后脚向右前收拢，与原来画面右下方的前脚并排站稳，两脚全掌平地、膝髋伸直，上身直立。关键：原图在右下方的前鞋完全不挪动，仍保持脚跟约在画面宽度53%处、鞋尖约68%处；只把左侧后脚送到这个前脚旁边。因此骨盆和上身应该向右移动至这只固定前脚正上方。禁止把原前脚向左撤回，禁止把人物重心居中重排。手随身体沿原长栏向右滑，左臂自然垂下，两只完整鞋、手和头部全在镜头内。写实康复教学摄影，灰蓝背景柔光，自然阴影。
attempts.reason: 只参考s03中文定向修正，结果改善有限，未复制到交付目录；之后主代理接手修正。

人物、器材及相机连续性为目视级匹配，不是摄影测量或像素级复刻。
